# TM Watch — US trademark similarity check + weekly Gazette watch


> Free instant similarity report for a brand name against every word mark
> in the US Trademark Official Gazette (applications published for
> opposition + registrations issued). The index covers 361,260 marks from 2026-05-05
> to 2026-09-01 (18 weekly issues, a new one every Tuesday). The report runs
> entirely in the reader's browser — no account, no server, nothing
> typed is transmitted. Matching = edit distance + phonetic + variant
> forms + a rare-shared-word rule; the matcher and its 45-pair USPTO
> §2(d) benchmark are open source. Source data is US public domain.

## Free data (stable, keyless HTTPS URLs)

- [Latest Gazette issue, CSV](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/APVentureEngine/trademark-watch/main/data/latest.csv): every word mark in the newest issue
- [Per-issue CSV archive](https://apventureengine.github.io/trademark-watch/data/): one immutable file per Gazette issue, plus a manifest
- [Issue manifest, JSON](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/APVentureEngine/trademark-watch/main/data/manifest.json): every published issue file with row counts
- [Full rolling index on Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/datasets/APProjects/uspto-trademark-gazette-word-marks): the same records as a dataset
- [Matcher benchmark results](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/APVentureEngine/trademark-watch/main/benchmark/RESULTS.txt): per-pair recall/false-positive table, regenerated every run

## Tools and pages

- [Instant similarity report](https://apventureengine.github.io/trademark-watch/): type a name, get flagged marks with USPTO TSDR links
- [Permalink form](https://apventureengine.github.io/trademark-watch/?q=BRAND+NAME): pre-fills and runs the check on load — safe to link to
- [Newly published marks by class](https://apventureengine.github.io/trademark-watch/filings/): 45 pages, rebuilt after each issue
- [Trademark watch services compared](https://apventureengine.github.io/trademark-watch/compare.html): dated prices for the paid alternatives, including where they beat us
- [What happens in the 30-day opposition window](https://apventureengine.github.io/trademark-watch/opposition-window.html): timeline, extension deadlines and current TTAB fees, dated
- [Source, matcher and pipeline](https://github.com/APVentureEngine/trademark-watch)

## Paid

- Free 30-day watch of one mark (no card): https://approj.gumroad.com/l/tm-free-watch
- $49/year watch of one mark, one payment, no auto-renewal: https://approj.gumroad.com/l/pwvfma
- Alerts are delivered as a private alert page plus an RSS feed. Email alerts are not built yet.

## Limits worth quoting accurately

- United States only; word marks only (design-only logos are out of scope).
- The searchable window is a rolling ~4 months of Gazette issues, not the whole US register.
- A flag means "a human should look", not "this is infringement". Not legal advice.
